independent_checks.aggregation: Within each source average seed 43 and seed 44, then seven sources equally. Not equal weighting of A/B batches.
independent_checks.direct_inputs: SHA-verified original D0/G0 score files, SHA-bound r1 score files, EXIT-bound r2 score files; not recomputation through the root summarizer.

selection_assessment.Q1r2: Reasonable main candidate if image-to-video subject/background preservation is the declared priority; not an overall quality winner.
selection_assessment.Q2r2: Retain as quality tradeoff control: higher average background consistency, aesthetics and imaging quality than Q1r2.
selection_assessment.G0: Retain as indispensable baseline; Q1r2 does not dominate it.
selection_assessment.default_execution: Keeping fused_post is supported by the pilot timings; neither packed nor skip has a demonstrated stable benefit.
selection_assessment.Q1r1: Retain as stable historical reference; Q1r2 remains an I2V-fidelity-prioritized candidate, not a replacement established superior across quality and motion.

material_counterexamples: Q1r2 versus G0: aesthetics is lower by 0.0026111858231680734, with six of seven source means lower; this is not explained only by raft/eagle subject-consistency regressions.
Q1r2 versus G0: motion smoothness is lower by 0.0006425907054977777; guitar contributes a source decline about 0.004777.

Q1r2 versus Q1r1: six mean scores rise, but aesthetics rises only 0.000008727822984967912; I2V subject improves in only three of seven source means, and its aggregate sign reverses if eagle is omitted.

Q1r2 versus Q2r2: I2V subject/background have positive mean differences that stay positive under omission of any one source; aesthetic/imaging mean differences stay negative under the same sensitivity check. No statistical generalization is implied.
Q1r2 versus Dense: source means for I2V subject, motion smoothness and aesthetics are all lower in all seven sources.
positive_evidence: Q1r2 versus G0: I2V subject improves in seven of seven source means and thirteen of fourteen videos; I2V background improves in six of seven source means and twelve of fourteen videos.
Q1r2 versus Q1r1: subject consistency improves in five of seven source means; motion smoothness improves in all seven source means, with small absolute differences.
limits: Descriptive evidence from seven exposed sources and two seeds; no independent confirmation or statistical superiority claim.

Higher dynamic-degree threshold count alone does not establish better semantic motion. Continuous RAFT and CoTracker small receipts were SHA-checked; full server-side flow payloads were not downloaded or recomputed by this reviewer.
Semantic foreground/background and physical camera compensation remain NOT_MEASURED.
No visual review, GPU execution, new experiment, or implementation edit by this reviewer.

Root correctly notes that CoTracker reference amplitudes can change across candidate comparisons even with equal valid-frame counts because the jointly visible point sets change. Do not directly compare cross-version amplitude summaries without fixing the support. This reviewer does not infer better action from those amplitudes.

independent_motion_checks.conclusion: Greater flow norm is accompanied by worse directional agreement and larger orthogonal residual; this does not support an unconditional motion-quality improvement.
